h1: The Emerald Cove Koh Chang — a Klong Prao beachfront resort with a 50-metre seafront pool
intro: If you've travelled to Koh Chang over the years, the name The Emerald Cove Koh Chang may ring a bell — a large beachfront resort on Klong Prao Beach that opened back in 2004 and was once part of the Amari group · Its signature feature is a 50-metre pool that runs parallel to the sea, sitting right in front of the resort on the sand · All 165 rooms are spacious, from 50 sqm, set in lawned seafront gardens · From approx. ฿2,500/night · Note: the property has since undergone a major renovation and reopened as Dinso Resort & Villas Ko Chang under IHG — this review draws on guest sentiment from the Emerald Cove era for reference.

body.html: The Emerald Cove sits in the middle of Klong Prao Beach, a long stretch of sand many consider one of Koh Chang's best locations · Unlike some hillside resorts, this one is right on the sand — you can walk straight from the pool onto the beach · In front is a wide lawned garden dotted with loungers under the coconut palms, giving it the feel of a classic, roomy beachfront resort.

The heart of the resort is its 50-metre seafront pool set parallel to the sea, ringed with sun loungers on wooden decking and on the grass · Real guest reviews mention this pool again and again — long enough for a proper swim, not just a dip · Klong Prao Beach out front also draws praise for clear water, with the ability to wade out a long way at low tide, which makes it great for families with kids.

"The room was far bigger than expected — even the standard rooms start at 50 sqm · The long seafront pool is lovely and the water on the beach is so clear you can walk out a long way. Great value for a beachfront resort."

All 165 rooms occupy a gently curving three-storey building, ranging from Deluxe, Deluxe Ocean Facing and Grand Deluxe Ocean Facing up to Suites · What impresses guests most is the room size — even the entry-level rooms start at 50 sqm, all with balconies and some with full sea views · Décor is warm and simple, prioritising comfort and function over flashy design, which some find relaxing while others may find a touch plain.

On the dining side there's plenty of choice — The Cove Terrace by the pool, the Just Thai restaurant, the Sassi Italian restaurant and Breezes Bar by the beach, plus a coffee shop · The buffet breakfast earns praise for its variety, with both Thai and Western options · The spa, fitness centre and beach terrace round things out for a resort of this level · Some reviews note the Italian pasta sauces can be a little bland, though the pizza and fried dishes come off well.

There are honest caveats too · As a long-established resort with a fairly classic style, parts of the buildings and some rooms started to show their age in later years before the big refurbishment · A few guests experienced intermittent power outages, which reflects Koh Chang's island-wide grid rather than the hotel itself · And being a large resort, service can feel less personal than a small boutique property during busy periods.

The bottom line: in its day, The Emerald Cove was one of the best-value beachfront 4-star resorts on Klong Prao Beach — genuinely on the sand, with a long seafront pool and spacious rooms at an accessible price · It has since been refurbished into the 5-star Dinso Resort & Villas under IHG, with prices to match · If you want the same beachfront location on a tighter budget, it's worth comparing other Klong Prao beachfront resorts in a similar price band too.

faqTitle: FAQ — The Emerald Cove Koh Chang

faq.q: Is The Emerald Cove Koh Chang still open · has it changed name?
faq.a: The property underwent a major renovation and reopened as Dinso Resort & Villas Ko Chang under Vignette Collection by IHG from 2024 · It's the same resort in the same location on Klong Prao Beach, but upgraded to a 5-star level with higher prices · Always check the latest name and photos on the platform before booking.

faq.q: Where is The Emerald Cove on Koh Chang · is it on the beach?
faq.a: It sits in the middle of Klong Prao Beach, directly on the sand · Klong Prao is a long stretch that many rate as one of Koh Chang's best locations · You can walk straight from the pool onto the beach, where the water is clear and you can wade out a long way at low tide.

faq.q: How much does The Emerald Cove cost · what room types are there?
faq.a: In the Emerald Cove era, prices started around ฿2,500/night for a Deluxe room from 50 sqm · ranging up through Deluxe Ocean Facing, Grand Deluxe Ocean Facing and a One Bedroom Suite · After the Dinso rebrand prices rose, so compare several platforms before booking.

faq.q: What is the pool at The Emerald Cove like?
faq.a: The highlight is a 50-metre pool that runs parallel to the sea in front of the resort, right on the beach · It's long enough for a proper workout swim, ringed with loungers on wooden decking and the lawn · It's the feature guests mention most positively.

faq.q: Who is The Emerald Cove best for?
faq.a: It suits families and couples who want a Klong Prao beachfront resort at an accessible price · spacious rooms, a long seafront pool and clear water that's great for kids · It's not about flashy boutique design but about beachfront location and value · After the Dinso rebrand it leans more towards a 5-star resort experience.
